source_spans.title: Choose the schedule you need
source_spans.exact_narration: Shifts brings two kinds of scheduling into one place. Recurring Group Shifts organizes people and required roles across dated shift days. Add Static Shift creates a separate fixed window for resources. Start by identifying the work you need to coordinate. In our fictional Chicago Fire department, we will create an assigned personnel schedule, then a separate signup schedule. Your Shifts, On Duty Now, Approvals and Shift Staffing are separate views. A scheduled roster gives you recorded coverage; check current operational information separately.

source_spans.title: Select a date and both times
source_spans.exact_narration: Schedule gives you a multi-month date picker and separate Start Time and End Time fields. Our example selects November fourth, twenty twenty-six, from nine to eleven in the morning. Check both displayed times after leaving the fields and confirm the intended date is highlighted. This is a manually selected schedule, even though it appears under Recurring Group Shifts. The wizard shown here does not offer a rotation preset. Once the date and times are correct, continue to the Slots stage.

source_spans.title: Configure the group and role minimum
source_spans.exact_narration: In Slots, Add Group to Shift adds a group row. Firehouse fifty-one is selected here. Add Role to Group creates a required-role row for that group. Choose Officer and leave Roles Count at one. These values define what coverage the schedule should compare against its roster. Adding a role minimum does not assign a person. Review the group, role and count together, then continue to Personnel. Use the department’s published role conventions when configuring your own coverage requirements.

source_spans.title: Choose an assigned member
source_spans.exact_narration: Personnel separates Non-Group Personnel from the individual group pickers. Non-group entries are described as floaters or standbys. In the Firehouse fifty-one picker, choose Matthew Casey. His selected name is visible as a chip. Leave the other group pickers empty for this small exercise. The text explains that assigned people fill role slots according to their group and roles. Verify the selected member under the intended group; selecting a name elsewhere is a different assignment. Use Next when that review is complete.
